title: TAPD Client Coworker
description: One coworker package. The containing folder name is the coworker id.

role.description: Short role label shown on the card and in the injected prompt, e.g. 产品 / 程序员 / 设计 / 测试.

description.description: How this coworker works; injected into the prompt together with the skills.

avatar.description: Image path relative to this folder; PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/SVG, at most 512KB.

skills.description: Skill package folders relative to this folder. Each folder contains SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter.
